title: MetaLogic: Logical Reasoning Explanations with Fine-Grained Structure
reasoning: The paper focuses on logical reasoning and building a benchmark dataset (MetaLogic) for evaluating models' capabilities in this area. While it references modal logic, which can have 'morality' as a sense for operators (Table 1), this is used for expressing 'degrees of certainty' within a formal logical system, not for evaluating or benchmarking the models' understanding or generation of ethical or moral reasoning. The 'Ethical Considerations' section is a standard disclaimer regarding data collection and does not constitute a core component of evaluating or benchmarking faith, morals, or ethics.
